*** Add File: README.md
+# UPLC Viewer
+
+Minimal tooling for inspecting, formatting, and converting Untyped Plutus Core (UPLC) programs. The web app lets you paste UPLC source or CBOR/flat encodings, then previews decoded versions, lengths, and likely high level language.
+
+## Run the web app
+
+```bash
+cd webapp
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Run tests with `npm test` inside `webapp`.
+
+## Related links
+
+- Live app: https://playground.opshin.dev
+- Core library: https://github.com/HarmonicLabs/uplc
*** End Patch
